title: Package config
description: JSON form of the package config: a 'pw-perf.config.json' file and the effective config snapshot in the run report. The 'default' keywords are the single source of default values (03-REQ-05). The TypeScript input type additionally accepts RegExp in url patterns and a keyBuilder function (03, chapter 5).

$schema.description: Optional, for editor support in JSON config files.

run.description: How the measurement run is executed (01, 04).

env.description: Environment label (D-18). Overridden by PW_PERF_ENV. Null: no label, one set of thresholds files.

passes.description: Passes of the test command (D-03, D-39): the command runs once per pass and every test runs once in each pass. Overridden by PW_PERF_PASSES for the current mode.

thresholds.description: Passes in a thresholds derivation run.

grep.description: Only tests whose title or tags match this regular expression run in perf mode, e.g. '@perf' (03-REQ-25). Applied case-insensitively to the projects that are measured (all but setup and teardown projects, 04-REQ-18); setup and teardown projects run in full. null: all tests.

keepReporters.description: Reporters kept in perf mode by name, as in the Playwright reporter config (e.g. 'junit', 'allure-playwright'). By default withPerf() keeps only the console reporters line, dot and github (list becomes dot; name list here to keep it) and the package reporter (D-23, 04-REQ-32).

resourceTypes.description: Playwright resource types that are measured. WebSocket traffic is not available as Request events in Playwright and cannot be measured (05).

ignoreExtensions.description: Requests whose URL path ends with one of these extensions are skipped, except resource type 'document' (05).

include.description: When not empty, only requests whose URL matches at least one pattern are measured.

exclude.description: Requests whose URL matches any pattern are skipped. Applied after include.

excludeKnownThirdParty.description: Skip requests to the built-in list of analytics, tag manager, monitoring and chat hosts (05).

successStatuses.description: HTTP statuses counted as successful samples: a class like '2xx' or an exact code like '404'.

steps.description: Durations of test.step steps as keys of kind 'step' (06). true (default) enables with defaults, false disables, an object enables with settings (03-REQ-18).

enabled.description: Default true when an object is given.

include.description: When not empty, only steps whose step key part matches at least one pattern give samples (06-REQ-22).

exclude.description: Steps whose step key part matches any pattern give no samples; exclude wins over include.

maxDepth.description: Deepest step level measured; deeper steps are included in their ancestor's time (06-REQ-21).

categories.description: Playwright step categories measured (06-REQ-20). Steps of other categories are transparent for keys and depth.

groupBy.description: 'step': one key per step path across tests; 'test': one key per test and step path (06-REQ-23).

normalizeTitles.description: false skips the key-stability rules (ids, dates, numbers); privacy rules always apply (06-REQ-35).

redactQuotedValues.description: true replaces quoted values in step titles with :value; by default they stay in keys (06-D-26).

pendingTimeoutMs.description: How long the collector waits at test end for requests still in flight (05).

keys.description: How raw URLs become endpoint keys (07).

origins.description: Origin to label mapping, e.g. {"https://api.example.com": "api"}. A key with * is a host pattern, e.g. "https://*.ci.example.com" (one * per host label, never across a dot); an exact entry wins over a pattern. The origin of Playwright use.baseURL gets the empty label unless mapped here. Other origins are labeled with their host.

idPatterns.description: Built-in path segment patterns replaced with ':id' (07).

hex.description: Hex strings of at least 16 characters.

token.description: Tokens of at least 24 characters containing a digit, without separators or with mixed case (07-REQ-08).

mixed.description: Random-looking ids of at least 16 characters with a digit, a lowercase and an uppercase letter, e.g. nanoid (07-REQ-08).

extraIdPatterns.description: Additional path segment patterns replaced with ':id'. A string matches a whole segment literally; a regex is tested against the segment.

query.description: 'names': keep sorted parameter names; 'ignore': drop the query string entirely.

keepQueryValues.description: Query parameters whose values are kept in the key, e.g. ['type'] gives '?type=open'.

dropQueryParams.description: Query parameter names always removed from the key (e.g. cache busters with fixed names).

keyBuilder.description: Snapshot only: "[function]" when a custom keyBuilder function was configured (TypeScript/JavaScript config).

checks.description: What is checked for every key (09) and how thresholds are derived for it (10). Each rule: enabled, minSamples, limit (for keys without an entry in the thresholds file) and margin (headroom added when deriving thresholds).

median.description: Median (p50) must not exceed the limit.

minSamples.description: Minimum samples for the rule to run (09-REQ-07).

margin.description: Headroom added to the source run value when deriving this limit (10, chapter 5).

smallSampleRelative.description: Relative headroom when the key has fewer than thresholds.smallSampleN samples.

limit.description: Limit in ms for keys without an entry in the thresholds file (00, 4.5).

percentile.description: The percentile chosen in level must not exceed the limit.

minSamples.description: Minimum samples for the rule to run (09-REQ-07).

level.description: Which percentile this rule evaluates, e.g. p95 (the thresholds file records it as evaluatedPercentile).

limit.description: Limit in ms for keys without an entry in the thresholds file.

margin.description: Headroom added to the source run value when deriving this limit (10, chapter 5).

smallSampleRelative.description: Relative headroom when the key has fewer than thresholds.smallSampleN samples.

p99.description: p99 must not exceed the limit.

minSamples.description: Minimum samples for the rule to run (09-REQ-07).

margin.description: Headroom added to the source run value when deriving this limit (10, chapter 5).

relative.description: Relative headroom over the source p99.

minGapMs.description: The p99 limit is at least this many ms above the percentile limit.

minGapRelative.description: The p99 limit is at least this share above the percentile limit.

limit.description: Limit in ms for keys without an entry in the thresholds file.

slowShare.description: Rules on the share of slow responses, relative to the Apdex threshold T. Run only for keys with a key-specific T from the thresholds file (09-REQ-07).

t.description: Apdex threshold T: satisfied below T, tolerated up to 4T (08). Used by the apdex and wilson rules, which run only for keys whose thresholds file entry has a key-specific t (09-D-12). These settings bound the derived T (10).

max.description: Upper clamp of derived T; when p50 is above it, t, minApdex and maxWilson are null (10-D-13).

medianFactor.description: Derived T is at most medianFactor × p50.

max.description: Upper clamp of derived T; when p50 is above it, t, minApdex and maxWilson are null (10-D-13).

medianFactor.description: Derived T is at most medianFactor × p50.

apdex.description: Apdex(T) must not fall below the limit (upper confidence bound compared, ADR-0010). Runs only for keys with a key-specific T from the thresholds file.

minSamples.description: Minimum samples for the rule to run (09-REQ-07).

margin.description: Headroom added to the source run value when deriving this limit (10, chapter 5).

smallSampleAbsolute.description: Subtracted when the key has fewer than thresholds.smallSampleN samples.

limit.description: minApdex for hand-written thresholds file entries that set t but omit minApdex (02-REQ-21). Keys without an entry never run this rule (09-D-12).

wilson.description: Share of samples slower than T must not exceed the limit (lower Wilson bound compared, ADR-0010). Runs only for keys with a key-specific T.

minSamples.description: Minimum samples for the rule to run (09-REQ-07).

margin.description: Headroom added to the source run value when deriving this limit (10, chapter 5).

factor.description: Multiplier of the source share of slow samples.

min.description: Lower clamp of the derived limit.

max.description: Upper clamp of the derived limit (self-consistency may exceed it, 10-REQ-05).

smallSampleMin.description: Minimum limit when the key has fewer than thresholds.smallSampleN samples.

limit.description: maxWilson for hand-written thresholds file entries that set t but omit maxWilson (02-REQ-21). Keys without an entry never run this rule (09-D-12).

errors.description: Error rate must not exceed the limit (lower Wilson bound compared, ADR-0010).

minSamples.description: Minimum samples for the rule to run (09-REQ-07).

statuses.description: Request statuses counted as errors by the 'errors' rule (08, 09): a class like '5xx', an exact code like '429', FAILED (request failed without a response, not aborted), ABORTED (cancelled by the browser, e.g. on navigation), PENDING (still in flight at test end).

limit.description: Limit for keys without an entry in the thresholds file.

margin.description: Headroom added to the source run value when deriving this limit (10, chapter 5).

factor.description: Multiplier of the source error rate.

gate.description: Gate policy: when violations fail the run (09, D-16, D-17).

tolerance.description: Number of keys with violations that is still tolerated: an integer, or a percentage of evaluated keys like '5%'. 0: every violation blocks.

hardLimitFactor.description: A time check exceeding limit x factor always blocks, regardless of tolerance. Null disables hard limits.

defaultThresholds.description: 'block': violations on keys evaluated with default thresholds can fail the run; 'warn': they only warn.

maxFailedTestShare.description: Highest share of failed test executions (unexpected / executed, skipped excluded) for which the run result is still trustworthy. Above it the run ends with tool error TESTS_FAILED_TOO_MANY (exit code 3, 09). Failed tests below it are a warning only: in perf mode the performance result decides (00, chapter 11).

preset.description: Headroom preset for derived thresholds (D-41, 10-REQ-23): sets the defaults of every checks.*.margin; margin fields set explicitly win. strict: small headroom, catches smaller regressions, more false alarms on a noisy environment. normal: recommended start. loose: large headroom, only clear regressions, for shared noisy environments.

dir.description: Directory of thresholds files, relative to the Playwright config directory.

update.description: 'all': recompute every unlocked complete entry (with hysteresis, 10); 'new-only': add entries for new keys, keep existing ones.

smallSampleN.description: Keys with fewer samples get the small-sample headroom (checks.*.margin.smallSample*) when deriving thresholds (10).

hysteresis.description: When re-deriving, an existing unlocked entry keeps its limit if the new value differs by less than this (10-REQ-18). Avoids noise-only diffs.

relative.description: For ms limits: relative difference, e.g. 0.1 = 10%.

ratio.description: For ratio limits: absolute difference. At most 0.01 so a kept entry stays self-consistent (10-REQ-05).

loosenWarnRelative.description: Warn (THRESHOLDS_LOOSENED_MUCH) when a derived time limit grows by more than this share (10-REQ-20).

dir.description: Directory of report.json and report.html, relative to the Playwright config directory. Emptied when the first test of a test or thresholds run starts; never the project directory or a folder with thresholds files.

rawUrls.description: Include raw URLs of the slowest samples in the run report (D-11).

seed.description: Seed of the sampling random generator (P-06).

urlPattern.description: A string matches as a case-sensitive substring of the full URL; {regex, flags} is a JavaScript regular expression.

derivationSettings.description: Effective settings used to derive a thresholds file of one kind: T settings of that kind (checks.slowShare.t.<kind>), thresholds.smallSampleN and the margin of each rule (snapshot, 10).

max.description: Upper clamp of derived T; when p50 is above it, t, minApdex and maxWilson are null (10-D-13).

medianFactor.description: Derived T is at most medianFactor × p50.
